DATABRICKS_HOST.description: Your workspace or the account console. An address.

DATABRICKS_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Needed for account-level rather than workspace-level work. An identifier.

DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID.description: A service principal, half of an OAuth pair. Databricks does not separate it as publishable.

DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Shown only once. Its scopes are fixed at creation and cannot be changed, so narrowing them means generating another.

DATABRICKS_TOKEN.description: The older personal access token. Databricks says to save it securely and not share it, and revokes one automatically after ninety days unused.
